name: Hat Yai International Airport

hours.v: aerodrome operator 06:00-24:00 local (2300-1700 UTC); air traffic services 24 hours

curfew.v: operations outside aerodrome hours (00:00-06:00 local) need prior approval from the airport authority
curfew.quote: Inform the airport authority, and approval must be received before such operation.

customs.v: customs and immigration within aerodrome hours, 06:00-24:00 local

fuel.v: Jet A-1 and AVGAS 100LL by PTT; fuelling 07:00-20:00 local (0000-1300 UTC), 20:00-07:00 on request 1 hour before landing
fuel.quote: AD 0000-1300, from 1300-2359 shall be requested 1 hrs. prior landing

handling.v: handling 06:00-21:00 local (2300-1400 UTC); 21:00-24:00 on request 3 hours before landing
handling.quote: AD 2300-1400, from 1400-1700 shall be requested 3 hrs. prior landing.

notes: Operator Airports of Thailand (AOT).
